packageRules.description: typescript-5 gives openapi-typescript 7 the TypeScript 5 compiler API that TypeScript 7 no longer ships (scripts/nixie-api/generate-nixie-api-types.ts), so it stays on 5

nixos/packages/onidel-provider.nix pins the provider's Go modules with a vendorHash, which Renovate cannot recompute, and no required check builds it, so a provider/go.mod bump waits for review: the reviewer updates the hash and dispatches the NixOS checks. groupName null keeps it out of the weekly patch group, which would otherwise wait with it
